title: Drug Deaddiction session for school students
summary: On 14th October, an awareness session on Drug and alcohol deaddiction by Rtn Dr Nilam Gada was conducted for around 80 students of St. John's Secondary Marathi Medium school students.
description: On 14th October, an awareness session on Drug and alcohol deaddiction by Rtn Dr Nilam Gada was conducted for around 80 students of St. John's Secondary Marathi Medium school students. The students were made aware of the physical and mental effects of addiction. Through Role play activities, they were taught how to handle peer pressure, say NO to drugs and alcohol. The session was very interactive and students gained clarity and were happy to learn about the long term effects. All the students took a pledge on "Say no to Drugs" and also assured that the awareness will be shared with their friends and other fellow students. The teachers were glad and thankful for conduting the awareness session as it was the need to the hour and students were educated on this sensitive topic. The school looks forward to conducting more such sessions in the coming months.
